baseline_source.text: וַ/תְּחַסְּרֵ֣/הוּ מְּ֭עַט מֵ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְ/כָב֖וֹד וְ/הָדָ֣ר תְּעַטְּרֵֽ/הוּ׃

baseline_english: Yet you made him a little lower than God[a], and crowned him with glory and honor.
intent: Test whether the Hebrew form compels God rather than divine/heavenly beings, and whether selected Greek angels requires different Hebrew letters. Do not decide by original-language priority or harmonize Hebrews back into the Psalm.

candidates.A: Yet you made him a little lower than heavenly beings, and crowned him with glory and honor.
candidates.B: Yet you made him a little lower than God, and crowned him with glory and honor.

identity_mapping_withheld_from_reviewer.B: current POB with note marker removed

rubric: Whole Psalm literary function and representative singular
policy: Keep same Hebrew consonants/vowels and representative singular
No inference of fresh manuscript ink from supplied QDR words
NT quotation is related reception evidence, not an independent Hebrew copy
One bounded comparison, no judge-until-agreement loop
predeclared_outcomes: Retain if alternative is viable but not demonstrated superior
Change only for justified same-source meaning improvement, followed by separate full-record application
Hold source priority absent discriminatory surviving evidence
